message.subject: Adapter piece HI – annual terms
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. For part:320050, we propose EUR 15.00 per piece with payment at 90 days net, for 6,650 pieces over 12 months; all other enquiry terms remain unchanged.
Our volume forecast for this part is up 13.1% (fc:320050@2026-09), giving a stronger annual volume basis.
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% (sc:70270@2026Q3), so we also need your commitment to improving delivery reliability.
Please review this package and confirm your best revised terms.

batch.note: Opening counter below increase, trading annual volume and seeking extended payment; immediate acceptance is materially more costly and no alternative is available.

trace.final_text: Counter-offer sent: €15.00 per piece, payment at 90 days net.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – revised proposal
message.body:
Thank you for reducing the price. We can move to EUR 15.15 per piece, with payment at 90 days net, for the unchanged annual quantity and 12-month term.
Your counter-offer leaves payment terms unstated. Please include the agreed payment period explicitly in your revised offer, and let us know whether there is a constraint preventing 90 days net.

batch.note: Supplier moved only 1.97% and ignored payment request. Small reciprocal price move preserves a broad gap while explicitly seeking the omitted payment lever; acceptance now costs 117139.78 and is premature.

trace.final_text: Revised offer sent: €15.15 per piece, with an explicit request for 90-day payment terms.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – next step
message.body:
Thank you for the further reduction. We can improve our proposal to EUR 15.25 per piece with payment at 90 days net; the annual quantity of 6,650 pieces and all other enquiry terms remain unchanged.
Please review the complete package, including the payment period, and send your revised term sheet.

batch.note: Two identical 2351.29 EUR steps suggest a fixed scripted price reduction, not the closest record's approval ladder. Continue small reciprocal moves rather than accept or jump toward its offer; payment remains unaddressed.

trace.final_text: Revised proposal sent: €15.25 per piece, payment at 90 days net.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – revised annual package
message.body:
Thank you for your continued movement. We can now offer EUR 15.30 per piece with payment at 90 days net, for 6,650 pieces over 12 months and otherwise unchanged enquiry terms.
Please confirm whether you can meet this package and state the payment period in your offer.

batch.note: Three identical price steps strengthen fixed-step interpretation; preserve price headroom and seek omitted payment lever. Compared shorter payment alternatives and acceptance; continuing is best while open.

trace.final_text: Revised proposal sent: €15.30 per piece, payment at 90 days net.

message.subject: Adapter piece HI – further revised proposal
message.body:
Thank you for your revised quotation. We can move to EUR 15.35 per piece, payment at 90 days net, with the annual volume of 6,650 pieces and all other enquiry terms unchanged.
Please send your best complete offer, explicitly including payment terms.

batch.note: Actual thread remains open beyond expected final timing, with four fixed reductions. Another small reciprocal price move is preferable to acceptance; revise if its reduction stops or status changes.

trace.final_text: Revised proposal sent: €15.35 per piece, payment at 90 days net.

batch.note: Accept final EUR15.72 with standard 14-day payment, cost107734.61. Checked longer-payment structures: 90 days would improve cost, but supplier has ignored five explicit requests and declared final. Higher price at 60 days saves only EUR4.61. No alternative and no demonstrated willingness to revise payment makes risking final offer unjustified.

trace.final_text: Accepted the final offer: €15.72 per piece, payment at 14 days net; total cost €107,734.61.
